# Aeethod — Sovereign TCG Commerce & Systems Studio

> Aeethod (aeethod.com) is a specialized vertical technology studio engineering custom digital commerce platforms, real-time multi-channel inventory synchronization meshes, and automated buylist infrastructure for high-growth Trading Card Game (TCG) retailers and collectibles enterprises.

## Studio Leadership & Team

- **Sadid Bin Hasan** — Founder & Principal Systems Architect
  - Specialization: Core Systems Architecture, Omnichannel Sync Meshes, Algorithmic Repricing, High-Concurrency Headless Commerce.
  - Background: Pokémon card collector as a personal hobby who built autonomous agents, web architectures, and automation systems from his teenage years. Founded Aeethod to eliminate the margin drain and software bottlenecks facing high-growth card shops.
  - Profiles: [GitHub](https://github.com/SadidSD) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sadidbinhasan) · [Email](mailto:sadidbinhasan3@gmail.com)

- **Anika Zaman** — Lead Systems Developer (Creative Partner · Engineering)
  - Specialization: Backend Architecture, Real-Time Webhook Meshes, Sub-35ms Search Pipelines, Database Concurrency.
  - Background: Systems engineer with exceptional algorithmic rigor and precision. Architects zero-downtime data pipelines and race-condition-free inventory sync across TCGplayer, eBay, Shopify, and POS registers.

- **Nayem Hasan** — Head of Product Design (Creative Partner · Design)
  - Specialization: Collectibles UI/UX, Deep-Variant Matrix Interfaces, High-AOV Checkout Architecture, Design Systems.
  - Background: Product designer combining sharp aesthetic intuition with commercial vision. Designs fast, tactile, mobile-first interfaces that elevate card shops into modern luxury collectibles houses.

---

## Core Technical Differentiators & Benchmarks

1. **Sub-35ms Single Card Search & Filtering:**
   - Custom edge-indexed search layers filtering 100,000+ cards across set, condition, finish, language, and grading slab in under 35 milliseconds with zero page reloads.

2. **Sub-2-Second Omnichannel Inventory Synchronization:**
   - Real-time webhook mesh delisting sold singles from TCGplayer, eBay, and online storefronts within 1.8 seconds of an in-store counter POS sale, completely preventing double-selling.

3. **Elimination of Shopify's 100-Variant Ceiling:**
   - Proprietary Deep-Variant Matrix allowing 300+ card variations (conditions, foil finishes, languages, PSA/BGS slabs) on a single canonical product URL without splitting listings or destroying SEO equity.

4. **100% Code Ownership vs. Rented SaaS:**
   - Turnkey Next.js and React architecture with 0% ongoing sales commission cuts and $0/month SaaS rent. The client retains complete code, database, and customer relationship ownership.
